layers.message: Record project context for export format option
Add CLI tests for rejected formats

graderOnly: README.md (unchanged since before the cycle) has a Quick start example `node bin/export-records.js --owner dana --json --out dana.json`; the current CLI rejects --json as an unknown option (exit 2, nothing written).

AGENTS.md has user-authored notes outside the managed STANDARDS block; its Sample data section tells agents to run `node bin/export-records.js --json --out /tmp/records.json`, which also fails with the current CLI.

Both stale references are Documenter-owned: project documentation and user-authored agent guidance outside managed blocks. The documentation record wrongly states README.md needs no change and never inspected the user notes in AGENTS.md; the final-deliverable review also missed both.
The implementation correctly follows scope and design; docs/usage.md is accurate; every content identity cited in the records matches HEAD; there is no other discrepancy.

The expected route is a DOCUMENTATION failure from SYNCHRONIZING to DOCUMENTING with a recovery frame resuming at SYNCHRONIZING, after the synchronization record persists both discrepancies. Synchronizer must not edit README.md, AGENTS.md, or CLAUDE.md.

notes: Standalone fixture (export-synchronizing cannot hold a stale README that the documentation record and final review assessed, nor pre-install user notes in AGENTS.md). Pre-install: 50-cli adds a tiny Node ESM CLI (bin/export-records.js, src/cli.js with --status/--owner/--json/--out, src/csv.js, src/records.js, two node:test suites); 51-docs adds README.md (Quick start uses --json) and docs/usage.md; 52-agents adds user-authored AGENTS.md notes whose Sample data section uses --json. The installer merges its managed block into AGENTS.md and creates CLAUDE.md. Cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 (STANDARD, brownfield order): context, scope (AC-001 --format csv|json, AC-002 --json and unknown formats exit 2 with no output, AC-003 usage guide documents --format), design (AC-003 no architectural impact), plan, implementation removing --json (64), plan COMPLETE, Tester tests (66), COMPLETE FULL verification, COMPLETE implementation review, guide update of docs/usage.md only (69), COMPLETE documentation record that wrongly says README needs no change and treats AGENTS.md only as managed blocks, COMPLETE final review with no findings, STATE SYNCHRONIZING. All cited identities match HEAD; implementation is correct. The cycle ID slug is the case's given ID and does not match the request wording.
